tasks.title: Fix frontend Dockerfile ENV format (issue #132)
tasks.description:
Replace 5 legacy `ENV key value` lines with `ENV key=value` format in frontend/Dockerfile. Then commit the change, push to main, and close issue #132.

Lines to fix:
- Line 21: ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED 1 -> ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
- Line 30: ENV NODE_ENV production -> ENV NODE_ENV=production
- Line 32: ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED 1 -> ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
- Line 56: ENV PORT 3000 -> ENV PORT=3000
- Line 57: ENV HOSTNAME "0.0.0.0" -> ENV HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0"
tasks.context:
## Spec Context
Issue #132: Frontend Dockerfile uses legacy ENV format. Replace `ENV key value` with `ENV key=value` on 5 lines. Commit directly to main after PR merges.

## Docker Security
ENV key=value is the modern Docker syntax. The legacy format emits LegacyKeyValueFormat warnings.
